description: This Java source file defines the RemoveRelated class, which implements the <remove-related> element of a mini-language used within the OFBiz framework. The class handles removing related entity references based on configuration provided via XML, and integrates with OFBiz's entity and mini-language infrastructure.

classes.name: RemoveRelated
classes.description: Implements a method operation to remove related entities using OFBiz's entity framework. It processes an XML element to configure entity relation name and value field, executes entity relation removal, and gathers artifact info.

classes.name: RemoveRelatedFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RemoveRelated from XML elements.

methods.name: RemoveRelated(Element element, SimpleMethod simpleMethod)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes RemoveRelated with configuration from an XML element, validating attributes and preparing expander and accessor objects.

methods.name: exec(MethodContext methodContext)
methods.description: Executes the removal of related entities based on the configured relation name and entity value, handling exceptions and errors.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo(ArtifactInfoContext aic)
methods.description: Gathers artifact info, specifically the relation name used, for documentation or analysis.

methods.name: toString()
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the RemoveRelated object and its configuration.

methods.name: createMethodOperation(Element element, SimpleMethod simpleMethod)
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate RemoveRelated objects from XML configuration.

methods.name: getName()
methods.description: Returns the string 'remove-related' which is the name of this mini-language element.
